system.help: The system under study, labelled System: name or short description of a concrete technical unit that all three statements refer to. Free text with no effect on any computation; an empty text clears the field.

usefulFunction.help: The useful function the system is meant to deliver, labelled Useful function, best phrased as an activity. Free text with no effect on any computation; an empty text clears the field.

harmfulEffect.help: The harmful effect or compromise the system carries today and that the ideal final result is meant to dissolve, labelled Harmful effect / compromise. Free text with no effect on any computation; an empty text clears the field.

ifr1.help: The first level of the ideal final result: the system remains, the harmful effect disappears without a new mechanism. Free text, phrased as a present-tense state; no effect on any computation, an empty text clears the field.

ifr2.help: The second level of the ideal final result: the useful function exists without the system being present at all. Free text, phrased as a present-tense state; no effect on any computation, an empty text clears the field.

ifr3.help: The third level of the ideal final result: a resource already present in the supersystem takes over the function. Free text, phrased as a present-tense state; no effect on any computation, an empty text clears the field.

obstacles.help: The obstacles that separate the system from the ideal final result today — the actual task list. Free text, one per line; no effect on any computation, an empty text clears the list.
